hero.badge: The all-in-one school & TVET management platform
hero.subtitle: One unified platform for documents, assignments, teacher & student management, modules and assessments, competency-based TVET curriculum setup, and automated report generation — built for admins, teachers, and students alike.

featuresSection.title: Built for Modern Education
featuresSection.subtitle: Every feature designed with educators in mind — intuitive, fast, and genuinely delightful to use.

documentManagement.label: Document Management
documentManagement.desc: Upload, organize and preview notes, PDFs and class resources by module — with inline viewing and download tracking.

assignmentWorkflow.label: Assignment Workflow
assignmentWorkflow.desc: Create assignments with deadlines, collect submissions, grade in bulk, and return feedback — all tracked automatically.

teacherManagement.label: Teacher Management
teacherManagement.desc: Admins onboard teachers, assign them to classes and modules, and manage extra co-teachers per class.

studentManagement.label: Student Management
studentManagement.desc: Enroll students by level, trade and class year, bulk-import records, and track every learner in one directory.

assessmentModules.label: Assessment & Modules
assessmentModules.desc: Configure modules with weighted marks, then run Formative (FA), Integrated (IA) and Comprehensive (CA) assessments per class.

onlineAssessments.label: Online Assessments & Auto-Grading
onlineAssessments.desc: Build MCQ, matching and open-ended quizzes, share a timed link with an attempt limit — questions and options shuffle per student, the timer auto-submits at the deadline, and answers are auto-graded instantly (with manual grading for open-ended ones).

reportManagement.label: Report Management
reportManagement.desc: Generate student report cards, per-assessment breakdowns and full class performance reports, ranked automatically.

tvetCurriculumSetup.label: TVET Curriculum Setup
tvetCurriculumSetup.desc: Define Sector, Trade, Qualification Title and RTQF Level per class — fully aligned to competency-based TVET programs.

markApprovalFlow.label: Mark Approval Flow
markApprovalFlow.desc: Marks move through Draft → Submitted → Approved with admin review, so reports always reflect verified results.

smartAnnouncements.label: Smart Announcements
smartAnnouncements.desc: Class-wide or school-wide notifications with read tracking, so nothing important is ever missed.

groupCollaboration.label: Group Collaboration
groupCollaboration.desc: Teacher-led discussion groups with team leaders, plus optional peer-to-peer messaging within a class.

enterpriseSecurity.label: Enterprise Security
enterpriseSecurity.desc: Session-based auth, role permissions, encrypted file storage, and full activity audit trails built in.

anyDevice.label: Any Device
anyDevice.desc: Fully responsive admin, teacher and student portals — flawless on desktop, tablet, and mobile.

realTimeNotifications.label: Real-Time Notifications
realTimeNotifications.desc: A dedicated notification center with unread counts, mark-as-read and clear-all, so every grade, message and alert reaches the right person instantly.

directMessaging.label: Direct Messaging & Voice Notes
directMessaging.desc: Private teacher–student threads and peer chat, with voice notes and media sharing built right into every conversation.

curriculumSection.title: Competency-Based Curriculum, Configured Your Way
curriculumSection.subtitle: Every class is anchored to a real TVET program — Sector, Trade, Qualification Title and RTQF Level — so modules, assessments and reports always line up with the curriculum your institution follows.
curriculumSection.reportsSubtitle: Once marks are approved, every report below updates on its own — no spreadsheets required.

fa.name: Formative Assessment
fa.desc: Ongoing checks during teaching to track ongoing understanding.

ia.name: Integrated Assessment
ia.desc: Mid-term evaluation combining several learning outcomes.

ca.name: Comprehensive Assessment
ca.desc: End-of-term evaluation covering the full module scope.

draft.label: Draft
draft.desc: Teacher enters marks per student for the assessment.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.desc: Teacher submits the full mark sheet for admin review.

approved.label: Approved
approved.desc: Admin approves — marks lock in and reports update instantly.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.desc: Admin sends it back with a review note for correction.

studentReportCard.label: Student Report Card
studentReportCard.desc: A full per-student breakdown across every module, term and assessment type.

assessmentReport.label: Assessment Report
assessmentReport.desc: Ranked results for a single assessment, with class average and percentile.

classPerformanceReport.label: Class Performance Report
classPerformanceReport.desc: School-wide or per-class analytics across modules, sectors and trades.

howItWorksSection.title: Up and Running in Minutes
howItWorksSection.subtitle: No IT team needed. No complicated setup. Just a few clicks and your whole school is online.

adminConfigures.title: Admin Configures
adminConfigures.desc: Set up classes, enroll students, assign teachers, and configure settings in minutes.

teachersDeliver.title: Teachers Deliver
teachersDeliver.desc: Upload materials, create assignments with due dates, track submissions, and give feedback instantly.

studentsThrive.title: Students Thrive
studentsThrive.desc: Access everything in one place — notes, assignments, grades, and announcements always up to date.

faqSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqSection.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

faqs.q: How quickly can we get started?
faqs.a: Most schools are fully set up in under 30 minutes. Our onboarding wizard guides you through creating classes, adding teachers, and enrolling students step by step.

faqs.q: Does EDUPLA support TVET curriculum structures?
faqs.a: Yes — every class can be linked to a Sector, Trade, Qualification Title and RTQF Level. Modules inherit that structure, and Formative, Integrated and Comprehensive assessments are tracked per module automatically.

Once a teacher submits marks and an admin approves them, student report cards, assessment reports and class performance reports are generated automatically — always reflecting the latest approved marks.
Absolutely. All data is encrypted at rest and in transit. We never sell user data and comply fully with data-privacy best practices.
Lesson planning and document drafting work offline. Submissions and grading sync automatically when back online.
Yes — our District plan supports unlimited campuses with centralised reporting and per-campus admin roles.

finalCta.title: Ready to Transform Your School?
finalCta.subtitle: Join 120+ educators using EDUPLA to save hours each week and improve student outcomes.
